The above writ petition is filed with the following prayers:
"(a) Issue a writ of Certiorari or any other appropriate writ order or direction calling for the records leading to Exhibit P2 and P2(a) and quash the same;

(b) Declare that proceedings pursuant to issuance of Exhibit P2 and P2(a) are lapsed in view of Section 24(2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, and whatever proceedings initiated pursuant to Exhibit P2 and P2(a) are a nullity.

(c) Declare that survey of the petitioner's property and laying of survey stones in the property of the petitioner is illegal and hence the same is a nullity and direct the 7th respondent to remove the survey stones put in the property of the petitioner.
 WP(C) NO.3929 OF 2014  (d) Issue a writ of Mandamus or any other appropriate writ order or direction commanding the 1st respondent to hold a high level enquiry in to the disbursement and spending of Rs.34.31 Lakhs released to the 6th respondent as per Exhibit P3 order.
(e) Grant such other and further reliefs, which this Hon'ble Court may deem fit to grant in the facts and circumstances of the case."[SIC]
2. When this writ petition came up for consideration on 03.03.2014, this Court passed the following order;
"Admit. Learned Govt. Pleader takes notice for the respondents.

The learned Govt.

sentences.text: Respondents to file  WP(C) NO.3929 OF 2014 counter affidavit, if any, in the meanwhile."
3. Moreover, a verified petition is filed by the respondents.
The relevant portion of the same is extracted hereunder;

"The above Writ Petition has been filed challenging the notifications under Section 6(1) of the Kerala Survey and Boundaries Act, 1961 issued as a preliminary step for surveying the lands, for Land Acquisition under the old LA Act, 1894.

But, since the notification under Section 4(1) of the Act was not published before 01.01.2014, the date on which the new Act (RFCTLARR Act) came into force, the pending requisition has been returned to the requisitioning authority on 10.08.2018.
Hence, no proceedings for acquisition of the land of the petitioner is pending at present.

Since, the petitioner has no subsisting grievance at present, the above Writ Petition may kindly be disposed of at the earliest."
WP(C) NO.3929 OF 2014 In the light of the averments in the verified petition, no further order is necessary in this case.
Therefore, recording the order dated 03.03.2014 and recording the contents of the verified petition,
this writ petition is closed.
